## (A) QC pass and loss rates per experiment {#figs1a}

```{r figs1a-code, code=code_for("../script/FigureS1.R", "S1a"), eval=FALSE}
```

```{r figs1a-img, echo=FALSE, out.width="70%"}
knitr::include_graphics("assets/ExtendedDataFigure1/S1a_QC_RNA_ADT_by_IGT.png")
```

::: {.figcaption}
**Extended Data Fig. 1A.** Box plots showing, for each experiment (IGT), the
percentage of cells retained after quality control and the percentage of cells
removed due to low gene counts (RNA nGenes), high mitochondrial RNA content
(RNA dead cells), low protein counts, high non-specific protein signal, or
non-T-cell identity, relative to the pre-QC cell number. Experiments outside
the 1.5 × IQR whiskers are labelled. The summary tables are written to
`output/FigureS1/`; the sample-level one is published as Extended Data Table 3.
:::

## (B) Cells retained per experiment and sample {#figs1b}

```{r figs1b-code, code=code_for("../script/FigureS1.R", "S1b"), eval=FALSE}
```

```{r figs1b-img, echo=FALSE, out.width="90%"}
knitr::include_graphics("assets/ExtendedDataFigure1/S1b_ncells_by_IGT_and_sample.png")
```

::: {.figcaption}
**Extended Data Fig. 1B.** Number of cells per experiment (IGT) and per sample,
identified by unique hashtag (HT) within each experiment; points are coloured
by HT. The leftmost box pools all samples and gives the distribution against
which any one experiment should be read.
:::
